I found two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines in Moss's notes. Both notes are public files, so you can open them yourself:

1. **#PD-4492**, from `teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md` ("Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth," 5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next day's shift got through without manual help.
2. **#4419**, from `teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md` ("Moss: North cheat sheet," no date). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 during third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.

Moss's other notes mention tickets too, but they're for other accounts, so I left them out. The Central handoffs digest (2 Jan 2026) has #4409 and #4412 for Marrow Fieldworks and FR-882, a feature request from Marrow Agrisupply. Moss's other notes mention Quarrendon (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in) but don't give any ticket numbers.

Two things to watch for the deck:
- Marcus has a note about "Quarendon Freightways" (one "r"). That's a different company, not a Pemberline customer, so don't mix them up.
- I only looked at Moss's notes. I couldn't find any Quarrendon ticket or CRM files in the share, so there may be tickets these notes don't mention.
